data: Which of the lines in the graph shows the lowest accuracy for a batch size of 256?

The question asks which line in the graph shows the lowest accuracy for a batch size of 256. From the caption, we know that the figure shows development set accuracy for 5 languages on morphological inflection with different batch sizes. The lines in the graph represent different models or methods, and their positions relative to each other indicate their performance.

Looking at the graph, the line representing the "Vanilla Transformer" appears to be the lowest among all the lines when the batch size is 256. This can be verified by comparing the y-axis values of the lines at the point where the x-axis value is 256. The "Vanilla Transformer" line is positioned below the other lines at this point, indicating lower accuracy.
